notes.title: Patch 1.015 - Better dreams
notes.content:
Hello Friends,

First patch.

I've redesigned a couple of the dreams to make them a bit easier to do. The uniform colors were are not the best! Feedback received!

Few other fixes:
- Relax mode flow mode no longer shows weird symbols
- Relax mode no longer shows somna earnings
- Tweaked the merging a bit to make it less error prone
- UI fixes and optimisations including spelling/text
- Story age and text fixes, quite a few were wrong
- Fixed blurred textures on some of the books in your room
- other minor bug fixes

Thank you all who got on board early and supported this game! Super apprecaitive!

Hope you all have a great weekend.

If you need any help just drop an email to hello@playne.com or hit me up on discord!

Thanks,
Krish.

notes.title: Demo - Big Update!
notes.content:
I've been refining and tweaking Maya's Dream and am excited to share some big improvements based on all your feedback!

[b]Progressive Puzzles:[/b] I've changed up the game structure to start with smaller puzzles that gradually increase in complexity. This way, you'll have a chance to get the hang of things before diving into larger, more intricate puzzles.

[b]New Dream Image: [/b]A fresh, new dream image has been added to the game. I can't wait for you to discover it.

[b]Luna has a voice[/b]: Our favourite feline companion, Luna, now has a voice! Luna will also now give voice cues through the game.

[b]Powers Unlocked Gradually: [/b]In response to your feedback, powers will now unlock gradually throughout the game. This way, you can learn the ropes at your own pace without feeling overwhelmed.

[b]Earn Somna: [/b]As you piece together fragments of Maya's past, you'll now earn Somna. These can be used to buy back memories from your past in the form of mementoes and keepsakes.

[b]Room Transformation:[/b] As you accumulate Somna, you can purchase over a hundred different mementoes and keepsakes to transform your room. Each one can give your room a unique feel and provide various boosts.

[b]Improved Tutorial System:[/b] I've improved the onscreen questing/tutorial system for a smoother, more intuitive gameplay experience.

My biggest thanks go to Gaurav, Gus, Iceless, KalisChilde, Olm, PlaygueDragon, Sinomatic, SkebForty, and Sly for their invaluable feedback. I couldn't have made these changes without you.

I hope you'll love these changes as much as I do. Happy dreaming, and so let me know if you have any feedback or suggestions!

Thank you all,
Krish
